dialogue_texts: The mansion seems quiet today. No sign of Flandre at the moment.
What was that? Whose voice was that?
Just someone looking to have a word with the Scarlet Devil. Don't sound so surprised.
Qu-Queen Marisa!? Why are you in the mansion when this is Order territory?
Order territory? Seems more like I'm bored and looking for trouble.
The Scarlet Devil may be enjoying a day off today, but I'm not going to lead you to her.
In the meantime, my magic will prove you are not welcome!
